name: Bauble Maker
summary: Christmas and holiday ornaments: hollow baubles that print upright in vase mode with a screw-on cap, in 11 shapes with Japanese, Nordic, Art Deco, Gothic, Halloween, Easter and other patterns in relief or openwork, a name or logo; flat ornaments; and a star tree topper with a push-fit socket.
credits: Feature set after DSCMaker's bauble maker (dscmaker.shop); written from scratch.
